_comment: This package's `web/` half is DOM code, so the pure-Node root program cannot check it (the root takes packages/*/src + packages/*/test only, and has no DOM lib). It used to be checked ONLY where packages/patterpad happened to import it, which left anything unimported unchecked - that is how an undefined `CHUNK` and a CuePopup interface missing two of its own methods survived. `exclude` is inherited through `extends` and resolved against the ROOT, so it must be overridden here or this program silently checks nothing.
